_comment: What a pull_request run of this workflow measures. `workflow_dispatch` only registers for workflows that
exist on the default branch, so a change to this authority cannot be exercised by dispatch before it
merges; a pull_request run can. The candidate and the runner key are fixed HERE, in the authority, and are
read from the trusted checkout - never from the pull request's own inputs - so a rehearsal cannot be
pointed at a candidate of the author's choosing at dispatch time.
A pull_request run is a rehearsal and nothing more: the emitter records admissible_as_pin=false for it,
and the emit job refuses to attest a receipt carrying that mark, so a rehearsal produces an unsigned
artifact and nothing else. An earlier version of this note said verify-claim.yml independently refuses
any pin whose run is not a workflow_dispatch on main. That workflow does not exist in this repository;
until one does, a consumer must read provenance.admissible_as_pin itself.
The candidate below is chosen because it is a real commit that carries a real claim manifest, does not
touch the receipt authority, and is not an ancestor of anything this lane changes. It also satisfies the
bookkeeping rule: its manifest names its own parent as the code revision, and the one commit between them
changes claim-manifest.json and nothing else.
CORRECTION. An earlier version of this note said the previous candidate,
6feac016e3a0796d0c7b21d86426af0f1491a9c1, no longer qualifies, because its commit also wrote
.github/coordinator/service/receipts/verifier-r32.json. It qualifies again: a review established that the
list refusing it was on the wrong side - receipts/<name>.json is what this repository's manifest routine
really writes, 4 of the 11 manifest commits in its history, while the name the list did tolerate has never
existed - and that the truncation lever the prefix once was is now closed independently by the
300-file cap refusal. The pin is left at 7e7ac70e because that is the candidate whose suite has actually
been measured end to end (3667 tests, 289s, all 132 names the manifest requires passing), not because
6feac01 is ineligible.
